releaseNotes:
🎥 Chat Videos & Full Context Perfection Release (v1.2.1) by Dhiraj:
• 🎥 Chat Video Preservation: Automatically captures and saves videos (.mp4, .3gp, .mkv, .mov) from WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram & Messages.
• 📧 Complete Gmail & Message Context: Captures full email subjects, complete bodies, and recipient addresses without truncation.
• 👥 Group Member Attribution: Preserves member sender names and group threads cleanly.
• ⭐ Gmail Enabled by Default: WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, Messages & Gmail are saved out of the box; all other apps configurable.
• 🎬 In-App Video Playback & Gallery: Watch saved chat videos with play badges and share directly.
• 🔒 100% Offline Vault: All photos, videos, and texts are stored strictly offline on your device.
